subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat pane selector accessibility slice after conflict resolution while leaving the broader linear workspace and VoiceOver-friendly history work open?
rationale: The patch is focused and source/proof-backed, but it changes visible selector wording, has a protected maintainer label, overlaps larger accessibility product requests, and currently cannot merge cleanly.

options.title: Land Narrow Slice
options.body: Approve the visible row-number and localized accessible-label behavior after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace accessibility solution.

options.title: Request Wording Changes
options.body: Ask for different ordinal presentation or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the linear workspace and session-history accessibility direction is decided, accepting that this smaller improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Slice
recommendation.body: Approve the visible row-number and localized accessible-label behavior after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace accessibility solution.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent current-main Control UI chat/i18n history and is a good routing candidate for the branch refresh and UX acceptance decision.
